name: TMC the metals company Inc.
blurb: TMC the metals company is a deep-sea minerals exploration company focused on collecting, processing, and refining polymetallic nodules from the seafloor of the Clarion-Clipperton Zone (CCZ) in the Pacific Ocean. The nodules are rich in nickel, cobalt, copper, and manganese — critical metals for EV batteries, energy storage, and steel production. TMC holds exploration and commercial rights in two CCZ contract areas, positioning it as a pioneer in lower-impact sourcing of battery metals outside of land-based, China-dominated supply chains. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Vancouver, the company employs roughly 48 people and had a market cap of approximately $2.44 billion as of May 2026.
recent: TMC stock surged roughly +25% over the 30 days ending May 11, 2026, climbing from around $4.72 to $5.91, driven by NOAA issuing a full compliance determination for TMC's deep-sea mining application and a commercial nodule-recovery agreement with offshore contractor Allseas. Analyst price targets were raised on the back of these regulatory and partnership milestones, with the consensus target sitting near $9.25. The company's Q1 2026 earnings call was scheduled for May 14, 2026, a near-term catalyst that kept investor attention elevated.
